title: Monetary Units Act 2004
why: The Victorian statute under which fees and penalties are fixed by reference to fee units and penalty units, whose dollar values are fixed for each financial year by the Treasurer by notice (ss 4 to 8), with regulations converting amounts to units and units to amounts (s 9), notification of fees and penalties (s 10), the values for 2012-2013 (s 11) and the exclusion of the Subordinate Legislation Act 1994 from the fixing of units and annual rates (s 12).
topic: fee units and penalty units (monetary units)

text.converter: vic_convert_w2.py (stdlib zipfile + ElementTree over word/document.xml and word/endnotes.xml, run under Python 3.13; kept outside the repository). It fails on any paragraph style, run element or symbol character it was not written for.
text.conversion: The Word file was converted to UTF-8 plain text by Legalese Commons (vic_convert_w2.py: stdlib zipfile and ElementTree over word/document.xml and word/endnotes.xml). The table of provisions, running heads and footers are dropped; the cover is kept as the file prints it (twice). Each provision starts on its own line with its number; paragraphs are indented two spaces a level; the register's marginal history notes are kept as "[Side note: ...]" lines before the provision they annotate; tables are "| a | b |" rows; no-break spaces become plain spaces and no-break hyphens become hyphens. The Word file holds no equation, drawing, picture or embedded object, so there is no formulas sidecar. It holds one Symbol-font character, in s 11(3): a raised dot between "2" and "5%", which the authorised PDF prints as "2·5%"; it is carried as U+22C5 (DOT OPERATOR, the Unicode counterpart of the Symbol font's dot operator, stored in the Word file as code F0D7). The other symbol characters are the rule above Endnotes. Bold and italic (defined terms, Act titles) are not carried. The Word file has no Word endnotes, so no "[Endnote N]" lines appear; the Act's own Endnotes section (general information, table of amendments, explanatory details) is kept. Apart from the labels listed above, no non-space character is added, dropped or changed (checked by counting every character of the Word file's text against the converted text); line breaks and tabs inside a paragraph become spaces, paragraph ends are trimmed and empty paragraphs are dropped.
text.symbol_font_place: s 11(3): "2" + Symbol-font code F0D7 + "5%"; the authorised PDF prints "2·5%" with a raised dot; carried as U+22C5; pdftotext extracts it from the PDF as U+F0D7
known_conversion_artefacts: the cover (version number, title, number, version date) appears twice at the head, as in the Word file

ss 13 to 16 and Schedules 1 and 2 are repealed; the Word file prints each repeal as a margin note and a row of asterisks, carried as a "[Side note: ...]" line and a "* * * * *" line, so the text has no heading for them
the rule above Endnotes is 15 box-drawing characters (U+2550); the Table of Amendments is set between two lines of en dashes (U+2013), carried as printed
the Table of Amendments states "Ss 3−7" with a minus sign (U+2212) in the Word file; carried as printed
cells of the Table of Amendments are carried one cell per column, so a row reads "| Assent Date: | 13.6.12 |"

check_against_authorised_pdf_2026_11_12.method: The authorised PDF was converted with pdftotext -layout (table of provisions) and pdftotext -bbox (word boxes). Running heads, footers, the cover and the table of provisions (PDF pages 1 and 2, and the cover lines at the head of PDF page 3) were left out; margin notes were separated from the body by type size (word boxes 7.4 pt high, standing left or right of the body by page); the two sides were compared as word sequences and as bags of words; nothing else.

tokens_containing_a_digit.only_difference: the s 11(3) rate, the same character carried under two code points (U+22C5 here, U+F0D7 in the PDF extraction)

differences_all_accounted_for: the PDF cover reads "Authorised Version No. 008" and "Authorised Version incorporating amendments as at" where the Word cover reads "Version No. 008" and "Version incorporating amendments as at" (2 places)

Endnote 1 (General information): the Word file reads "current Versions of legislation" where the authorised PDF reads "current authorised versions of legislation"; this is the only difference in words, and it is in the Endnotes, not in the Act's provisions; the deposit keeps the Word file's words
s 11(3): the dot in "2·5%" is the same character under two code points (U+22C5 in the converted text, U+F0D7 as pdftotext extracts it); no difference of digits or amounts

reading order of two phrases in the Table of Amendments differs in the PDF extraction ("No. 33/2012" of the first entry and the label "Commencement Date:" of the 2024 entry, as ordered by word position); the same words are in both, as the bag-of-words comparison shows
